title: Polarity Classification with Multitask Learning Syntax Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a fundamental NLP task concerned with the identification and categorization of subjective information in text. While lexicon-based methods offer transparency, they often struggle with linguistic phenomena such as negation and intensification. Syntactic parsing has been integrated into SA pipelines to address this, but conventional parsers introduce significant computational overhead. Recent work shows that reformulating dependency parsing as a Sequence Labeling (SEL) task can improve efficiency. We propose and compare two strategies for integrating syntactic knowledge into a neural sentiment analysis model under unified Multi-Task Learning (MTL). The first, Standard-MTL, jointly learns dependency parsing (via sequence labeling) and sentiment polarity classification using a shared encoder with two task-specific heads. translated_title: 基于多任务学习语法增强的极性分类
translated_abstract: 情感分析（SA）是一项基础的自然语言处理任务，涉及对文本中主观信息的识别与分类。虽然基于词典的方法具有透明性，但它们在处理否定和强化等语言现象时常常表现不佳。为解决这一问题，句法分析已被集成到情感分析流程中，但传统句法分析器会带来显著的计算开销。近期研究表明，将依存句法分析重新表述为序列标注（SEL）任务可以提高效率。我们提出并比较了在统一的多任务学习（MTL）框架下将句法知识整合到神经情感分析模型中的两种策略。第一种是Standard-MTL，它使用共享编码器和两个任务特定的输出头，联合学习依存句法分析（通过序列标注实现）和情感极性分类。第二种是Contrastive-MTL，它通过对比辅助任务提供隐式的句法指导……
tldr: 该论文提出在统一多任务学习框架下，通过序列标注形式的依存句法分析与情感极性分类联合学习（Standard-MTL）或对比辅助任务隐式句法指导（Contrastive-MTL）两种策略，以较低的计算开销将句法知识融入神经情感分析模型，从而提升极性分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and compares two unified multi-task learning strategies—Standard-MTL and Contrastive-MTL—that efficiently integrate syntactic knowledge into a neural sentiment analysis model, either through joint sequence-labeling-based dependency parsing or implicit contrastive syntactic guidance, to improve polarity classification.
